source_sentence: The tag embedding ht is produced by ht = ReLU(Y [et(t1);...; et(t|Σt|)]) where et maps the tag tk into tag embedding ht k ∈ Rdt or zero vector 0 ∈Rdt, depends on whether the tag tk is presented.
